agent_explanation: Shrunk case is 2 heavy bodies (~17.89 and 19.70 Msun) with maximal G=5.0 and maximal dt=0.03012 (steps=16). Mutual gravity pulls them from ~3.9 apart to a close encounter comparable to softening length 0.3: distance 1.04 at step 14, 0.51 at step 15, 0.34 at step 16. At that separation forces are extreme (potential -3883, kinetic 3098 at step 16) and adaptive substeps (28 at step 16, 21 at step 15) are insufficient for leapfrog with this large outer dt. Energy goes from E0=-405.26 to -405.04 at step 14, -489.08 at step 15, -785.27 at step 16, a change of 380.01 vs allowed 139.68. Halving outer dt to 0.01506 with all else identical resolves the integration error and conserves energy.
